tei:div.tei:p: sde brgyad la gser skyems mchod thabs bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ sku gsum brgyud gsum bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang*// mkha' 'gro nor lha chos skyong sogs// mchod yul gong ma thams cad la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang*// lha min dbang po thag bzang ris// mi'am ci ljon rta mgo can// gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang*// mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa dang*// srin po laṅka mgrin bcu dang*// chos skyong ma hā kā la dang*// dri za zur phud lnga pa sogs// phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// yab gcig bdud rje nag po dang*// btsan rje yam shud dmar po dang*// yul lha phywa sangs klu sras dang*// srog bdag rgyal po snying 'byin dang*// chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar po dang*// lha mo 'jigs pa'i glog 'byin dang*// dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dang*// dkar mo nyi zla thod phreng sogs// nang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// bdud po kha thun raksha dang*// gshin rje gshed po dmar po dang*// klu bdud nā ga ra dza dang*// gnod sbyin shan pa gri thogs dang*// ma mo srid pa khram 'debs dang*// btsan po yam shud srog len dang*// bdud po re ti mgo nyag dang*// srog bdag dung gi thor tshugs sogs// gsang ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la// skar mchog khram shing kha 'thor dang*// bdud mchog ma nu raksha dang*// btsan mchog gri btsan 'thum po dang*// ma mchog lce spyang mdung 'dzin dang*// klu mchog klu rgyal dung skyong dang*// mgon mchog nag po lte dkar dang*// rgyal mchog li byin ha ra sogs// mchog gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// dpung g.yas dgra blar sprul pa dang*// dpung g.yon ma mor sprul pa dang*// mchu so bdud du sprul pa dang*// mgo bo srin por sprul pa dang*// mjug ma dmu ru sprul pa dang*// lag g.yas gshin rjer sprul pa dang*// lag g.yon klu btsan sprul pa dang*// mig dang snying dang mtshan ma gsum// gza' bdud nyid du sprul pa sogs// sprul pa'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// sa bdag hal khyi nag po dang*// klu bdud gdol pa nag po dang*// sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*// phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang*// mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*// yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang*// pho lha dgra lha srog lha dang*// mo lha mo sman la sogs pa// snang srid sde brgyad thams cad la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// zhes gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'o//

༈ kyai/ sa yul 'di la gnas pa yi// lha gnyan klu gnyan btsan gnyan dang*// yul lha gnyan dang nags tshal gnyan// yul lha mthu chen bzhugs pa rnams// rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /snga ma legs pa'i gtang rag dang*// phyi mar bcol ba'i zhu skyems 'bul// da ltar las kyi gnyer zas sogs// bzhes nas bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod/// /
